audit_items.proof_trace: The initial schema enables RLS on `member.team_leaders` with only a `service_role` policy, leaving `authenticated` effectively blocked. However, migration `20260317000001_fix_security_permissions.sql:L53-54` then explicitly creates `CREATE POLICY "Allow read access to authenticated users on team_leaders" ON member.team_leaders FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true)`, an unconditional SELECT grant for all authenticated users — directly violating the assertion `has_policy(team_leaders, authenticated, ANY) == false`. The `anon` role is properly blocked via `REVOKE ALL` (L39) with no RLS policy remaining; `generation_roles` is also compliant (SELECT-only policy for authenticated, no write access).
audit_items.attack_scenario: An authenticated club member issues `SELECT * FROM member.team_leaders` and receives the complete set of `{team_id, member_id}` leadership assignments; combined with the unrestricted SELECT on `member.members`, this enables full enumeration of organizational hierarchy including leader UUIDs, facilitating targeted privilege escalation or social engineering.
